items.text: The dependency `execute/cli-core-identity-consumer` is completed. `DetectIdentity()`, `VerifyIdentity()`, `IdentityEnv`, `VerifyResult`, and `VerifiedClaims` are all implemented in `packages/cli-core/cliutil/identity.go` and tested.

The `started_by` field already exists end-to-end: proto definition (field 12), API `Record.StartedBy`, CLI `--started-by` flag, and UI `execution-card.tsx` display. This is not greenfield — it's enhancement of existing infrastructure.

items.topic: Provenance data model for backlog items (spec.json `created_by`)
items.context: Backlog items currently have `spawned_from` (which item created this) but no `created_by` (who/what created it). We need to decide the shape of `created_by` in spec.json. This is immutable after creation and must support both operator and agent attribution.

options.label: Structured object: {type, run_id?, task_id?, profile_key?}
options.rationale: Rich provenance that can be queried and displayed directly. Matches the VerifiedClaims shape. Slightly more complex to serialize but spec.json already uses read-modify-write JSON.

options.label: Compact string: 'operator' or 'agent:<profile_key>/<run_id>'
options.rationale: Simpler storage, requires parsing for display. Consistent with how `started_by` currently works as a plain string. Loses structured queryability.

items.context: Execution records already have `started_by` as a string field in both the Go model and proto definition. We need to decide whether to keep it as a string (with a new encoding convention) or move to a structured type. Changing the proto field type would be a breaking change.

options.label: Keep string, use convention: 'operator' or 'agent:<profile_key>/<run_id>'
options.rationale: No proto changes needed. Backward compatible — old records keep their existing string values. UI parses the string for display. Simple and non-breaking.

options.label: Add a new structured `provenance` proto field alongside existing `started_by`
options.rationale: Clean separation: `started_by` stays as legacy display string, `provenance` carries structured claims. More fields to maintain but no ambiguity. Requires proto changes (out of scope per constraints).

items.topic: Identity middleware placement and verification caching
items.context: The API needs to extract and verify the identity token from incoming requests. Verification calls agent-manager over HTTP (localhost, ~ms latency). We need to decide the middleware approach.

options.label: Global middleware, verify once per request, cache result in context
options.rationale: Simple — every request gets provenance in context regardless of whether the handler needs it. Consistent with the existing loggingMiddleware pattern. One verification call per request max. Slight overhead for endpoints that don't use provenance.

options.label: Per-handler verification via a helper function
options.rationale: Only verifies when needed — no overhead on health/status endpoints. More flexible but requires each handler to opt in, risking inconsistency. Doesn't match existing middleware pattern.

items.context: The UI currently shows `startedBy` as plain text in execution cards. We need to decide how to visually distinguish operator vs agent provenance and how much detail to show.

options.label: Inline badge with icon: operator icon or bot icon + profile_key, clickable run link
options.rationale: Minimal UI change — replace the existing 'by {startedBy}' text with a small badge component. Bot icon makes agent attribution instantly recognizable. Run link enables tracing. Works within existing card layout.

options.label: Tooltip-only: show icon, full provenance details in hover tooltip
options.rationale: Keeps the card compact. Less visual noise. But provenance is hidden behind an interaction — users must hover to see details.
